title: Degree under an extended sign restriction
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $f\colon\{-1,1\}^n\to\{-1,1\}$, and choose a set $J$ of coordinates together with fixed signs on the coordinates outside $J$. Extend this restriction to a function on the whole sign cube by evaluating $f$ at the point whose coordinates in $J$ come from the input and whose other coordinates are the chosen fixed signs. Its real-valued Fourier degree is at most the depth of a decision tree computing the corresponding restricted function on the binary cube, where binary inputs are identified with signs.
hypotheses_covered: $J$ is a subset of the coordinates
A fixed sign is specified for every coordinate outside $J$
